title: About Me
description:
Hi, I'm Naveen Kumar, a Product Designer based in India with 5+ years of experience designing digital products across mobile, SaaS, and AI. I work across the full design process, from research and UX to interaction design, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff.

Over the past year, I've focused on AI product design, creating simple and intuitive experiences that balance technology, usability, and user trust.
